classification.countable_rule: excludes optional ingredients, water, salt, black pepper, and cooking oils
classification.notes: Effort: Steady prep (1); periodic attention while searing and simmering (1); broth+noodles as the main with one seared topping (1); sear plus keep-miso-below-boil timing (1); two pots converging at assembly (1). Sum 5 -> moderate. No floor rule triggered. Complexity: 14 countable (1). Miso, dried shiitake, ramen noodles, and nori are 3+ widely stocked international-aisle items (2), scored once; sourcing not double-counted (0). One broth build; the mushrooms take a splash of the same soy, not an independent sauce (0). Sum 3 -> standard. Cuisine adds no points.
